name: Ne tupoy
source:
"Nuh-uh, Semyon is not dumb. And not stupid. Semyon is smart. Semyon got it."

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2979011719]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“嗯嗯，谢苗并不傻。也不傻。谢苗很聪明。谢苗明白了。”
